cues.zh: 直接把這段複製貼進來。

cues.en: So this is particularly useful if you're saying something like an equals one and then I'm substituting NP in here like this.
cues.zh: 尤其當你先設一個替代值變數等於 1，再把這個變數代入這裡時，這很實用。

cues.en: OK, so that is one that solves one problem.
cues.zh: 好，解決了一個問題。

cues.en: Another thing I'd like to change, which isn't actually a problem, but I would like this to be an actual fraction.
cues.zh: 另一個想改的地方，倒不算問題，只是希望它看起來像真正的分數。

cues.en: I would like this to look a little bit more like a fraction rather than one slash X.
cues.zh: 希望更像分數，而非 1/x 這種斜線寫法。

cues.en: So to do that, I want to in case some of this stuff in latex code.
cues.zh: 所以想把部分內容包在 LaTeX 程式碼中。

cues.en: So we want latex code in the label.
cues.zh: 要在標籤使用 LaTeX。

cues.en: So you might think of doing something simple like Simborg Latex, but then it's actually just showing the latex code.
cues.zh: 你可能想到簡單地呼叫 sym.latex，但這樣只會直接顯示 LaTeX 程式碼。

cues.en: So this is probably even worse than the previous legend.
cues.zh: 可能比原本圖例還糟。

cues.en: So what we need to do is actually get this entire expression to be in latex.
cues.zh: 需要讓整個運算式以 LaTeX 呈現。

cues.en: Now, the way to do that is not by writing display and math functions.
cues.zh: 方法並不是呼叫 display 和 Math。

cues.en: Instead, the way to do that is to in case this expression in dollar signs like this and the dollar
cues.zh: 而是像這樣，把式子包在錢號之間，這些錢號，

cues.en: signs like this is the way to illustrate that inside this string, we are going to be using latex or this text should be interpreted as latex code.
cues.zh: 就是用來表示，字串內這部分要使用 LaTeX，或說要把文字當成 LaTeX 程式碼解讀。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 完成了。

cues.en: A little bit small maybe, but you can probably read it on your own screen that says Y equals one divided by X.
cues.zh: 也許有點小，不過在自己的螢幕上應該讀得到：y 等於 1 除以 x。

cues.en: OK, so that is for plotting one line.
cues.zh: 這是畫一條線。

cues.en: Now, what do I do if I want to plot two lines?
cues.zh: 想畫兩條線，怎麼做？

cues.en: So I want another function.
cues.zh: 需要另一個函數。

cues.en: Maybe I want to set a to be equal to two and to see how one over X compares with two over X.
cues.zh: 也許把 a 設成 2，看看 1/x 和 2/x 有什麼差別。

cues.en: So the way that you have to do that is by using a method associated with the plot object called extend.
cues.zh: 方法是使用繪圖物件的一個方法，叫 extend。

cues.en: So we say extend.
cues.zh: 呼叫 extend。

cues.en: And basically what we want to do is extend this plot object by one more element.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是替這個繪圖物件再增加一個元素。

cues.en: And what is that other element that we want to put in there?
cues.zh: 那要加入的另一個元素是什麼？

cues.en: So that other element is actually exactly this.
cues.zh: 其實就是這個。

cues.en: So one way you could do this or accomplish this goal is by saying, let's call this P2 and then I say extend P2.
cues.zh: 其中一種做法，是把這個叫 p2，再呼叫 extend(p2)。

cues.en: So this is going to be extended by or so A equals two.
cues.zh: 這樣就會擴充，這裡 a=2。

cues.en: And now just out of curiosity, to see what happens, I'm going to remove the X limit parameter inside this function.
cues.zh: 現在只是好奇，想看看會怎樣，所以把這個函數內的 x 範圍參數移除。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So this is looking kind of good.
cues.zh: 開始有樣子了。

cues.en: It's getting there.
cues.zh: 越來越接近。

cues.en: You can see there are two lines.
cues.zh: 可以看到兩條線。

cues.en: Now, the problem is both of these lines are blue.
cues.zh: 問題是，兩條都是藍色。

cues.en: So it's kind of hard to say which line is which function.
cues.zh: 很難判斷哪條線對應哪個函數。

cues.en: You can kind of tell because we know that this line was set to go from minus five to plus five.
cues.zh: 還是能稍微判斷，因為知道這條線設成從 -5 到正 5。

cues.en: And this line here corresponds to or has bounds at minus five and plus minus five.
cues.zh: 這裡這條，則對應界限在 -5 和正負 5。

cues.en: So that means that this one is actually so the inner line here is actually Y equals one over X and the outer one is Y equals two divided by X.
cues.zh: 所以，裡面這條其實是 y=1/x，外面這條是 y=2/x。

cues.en: But I think the bigger problem here is that the two lines have the same color.
cues.zh: 但我覺得較大的問題，是兩條線顏色相同。

cues.en: But you know how to solve that problem.
cues.zh: 你已經知道怎麼解決。

cues.en: We simply type P and then you can pick which line you want.
cues.zh: 只要輸入 p，再選想改哪條線。

cues.en: So let's say the first line, that line color equals oops.
cues.zh: 例如第一條，設定 line_color。哎呀，

cues.en: Ah, should have been ah.
cues.zh: 這裡應該用 r。

cues.en: All right, so that is looking pretty good and then I'm also going to specify the label for this second line.
cues.zh: 好，看起來很不錯。也要指定第二條線的標籤。

cues.en: So now this is no longer P zero.
cues.zh: 這次不再是 p[0]。

cues.en: This was P zero.
cues.zh: 剛才那個是 p[0]。

cues.en: This is P one.
cues.zh: 這個是 p[1]。

cues.en: So then this has to be a two.
cues.zh: 所以這裡得是 2。

cues.en: All right, this is starting to look pretty good.
cues.zh: 好，開始很不錯了。

cues.zh: 最後想示範的是，如果這裡 extend 方法的輸入，

cues.zh: 應該說，傳入 symplot 的內容沒這麼長，

cues.zh: 就能少寫一行，直接把 symplot 函數呼叫放進 extend 裡。
